text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm starting the handoff for the runtime metrics dashboards. Need alignment on exporter contract, agg windows, retention, and a safe backfill plan.

Tom: 👍 can you paste the minimal exporter payload you expect? will use that for the shim.

Maya: posted below — keep it tiny. fields: `service`, `host`, `metric`, `value`, `ts`, `tags` (map). prefer JSON-lines sink. Example:```json
{
  "service": "runtime-agent",
  "host": "gpu-02",
  "metric": "invocation_latency_ms",
  "value": 12.4,
  "ts": 1670000000,
  "tags": {"model": "gpt-4x", "route": "hosted"}
}
```

Sasha: sgtm. do we need histograms or summaries for p95/p99? or can we derive from raw values?

Maya: prefer storing raw samples for 30d and pre-aggregated histograms for longer. pipeline will emit 1m, 5m, 1h aggregates. p95/p99 derived from hist buckets.

Jess: retention numbers? cost estimate?

Maya: proposal: raw samples retained 30 days, 1m & 5m aggregates retained 90 days, 1h aggregates retained 365 days. long-term rollups only keep count/sum/histogram.

Liam: sounds reasonable. for cost modeling, estimate: raw samples ~ 120M events/day across clusters => ~2.4B over 20 days. we'll need compression + TTL to hit price targets.

Tom: aggregator job details? windowing semantics? exactly-once?

Sasha: planned design: streaming job (Flink) with event-time windows, allowed lateness 2m, watermarking. three aggregation layers: 1m tumbling, sliding 5m (stride 1m), 1h tumbling. we will emit both histogram (base64 proto) and simple metrics (count,sum).

Maya: important: dashboards depend on model/route cardinality dims. we should cap tag explosion by whitelisting keys: `service`, `model`, `route`, `env`. other tags go into a freeform `meta` blob for inspection but not dimensioned.

Jess: agreed on whitelist. can you add a reject metric and sampling counter so teams know when tags are dropped?

Maya: yes — export `metrics.tags_dropped{key=...,service=...}`. telemetry-bot: can you create an alert for sudden tag-drops? :alarm_clock:

telemetry-bot: alert created -> ID: MET-DEV-4821, channel: #eng-sre, threshold: >100 dropped tags/min.

Tom: backfill plan — how to do without blowing up prod? idea: throttled replays via a backfill job that reads raw archives and writes to the same ingest topic with a backfill flag. consumer will treat backfill records with lower priority and rate-limit them.

Sasha: +1. add circuit-breaker: per-pipeline qps cap and error budget. default backfill rate 1000 events/s cluster-wide, can be increased by eng-platform if infra idle.

Maya: timeline: schema & exporter shim merged by next Tue, aggregator infra changes by Fri, backfill window starting next Mon (3 days), dashboard panels ready by end of week after backfill. owners: eng-platform (Tom, Maya) implement pipeline + config; eng-ml (Sasha) validates histogram correctness; eng-sre (Jess) monitors cost/alerts.

Liam: I'll run a quick cost sim and post numbers by EOD. make sure we tag all test runs `backfill=test` to avoid billing surprises.

Jess: are we OK with retention legal/compliance? any PII concerns in `meta`?

Maya: no PII should be in metrics. we'll add a data-check in the exporter shim to redact `meta` if it matches known patterns.

Tom: action items:
- Tom: create exporter-shim PR with example payload + unit tests (due Tue)
- Sasha: update Flink job with histogram buckets + lateness handling (due Fri)
- Maya: whitelist tag list + alert for tags_dropped (due Mon)
- Jess: cost alert + backfill circuit breaker runbook (due Mon)
- Liam: cost simulation numbers (EOD)

Maya: also, small UX ask for Console team: add a toggle on runtime dashboards to switch between `raw` and `aggregated` views and a pre-rollup time selector (30d vs 90d). @console-product please weigh in.

telemetry-bot: noted. dashboard request filed -> DASH-3145.

Sasha: one more: export schema versioning. add `schema_v` to exporter json, bump when fields change. backfill should include `schema_v` so aggregator can handle older shapes.

Maya: good call. include `schema_v: "1"` in the example payload.

Tom: ok will start on the shim. thanks all — we'll reconvene on Monday standup if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
